name: knight
prompt: Create an ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of ONLY the KNIGHT, matching column 1 of the reference image. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, EIGHT frames total, requested canvas 2048x1200, each cell512x600. Row1 FOUR sequential keyframes healthy IDLE BREATHING: exhaled, half inhale, full inhale, half exhale. Row2 FOUR sequential keyframes WOUNDED HEAVY BREATHING, same character with reference wounds: head lowered, shoulders down; shoulders rising; shoulders raised with strained head lift; settling down. These are animation frames of ONE SAME CHARACTER, identical face, armor, costume design, colors, scale, camera and framing. Small but visible articulated shoulder/chest movement, head 1-2degree nod, cape/hood tips settle with slight delay. Fixed lower torso anchor. NOT whole portrait translating, NOT different costumes or rotations. Each portrait is threequarter facing RIGHT, bust fully enclosed in identical SHIELD shaped aperture with flat slightly rounded top, vertical sides until lowerthird then taper to centered bottompoint. Aperture occupies92%cell with4%padding, absolutely NO FRAME or border, inside uniform solid charcoal RGB19,17,22, outside transparent alpha0. Head stays upperthird; don't crop head crest. Gothic angular grotesque, coarse crisp pixel contours, bone219194166 burgundy871842 dusty lilac charcoal vermilion. Flat 3-4shade illustration matching reference, NO smooth gradient no bloom no blur no text no labels no gridlines. Preserve exactly the knight reference identity and both health states. Animate anatomy and cloth subtly across the four columns; no changes to background or shield mask.
